title: React to a comment
description: Every comment on a task can take a quick reaction — Like, Love, Celebrate, Haha, Seen or Done — so "got it, thanks" no longer needs a comment of its own.
items: The smiley button under a comment opens the picker; pressing a reaction again takes yours back
Each reaction shows how many people chose it, and yours is highlighted
Hover a reaction to see who reacted
pending: The status doc records the reactions migration as written but not yet applied. Until it is, comments show no reaction bar.
